headline: Debunking Mythos Social Engineering
caption: Just read the trending story on Hacker News about Mythos social engineering. It’s a classic example of how attackers manipulate our trust and routines. As developers and engineers, we often focus on code and infrastructure, but this shows the importance of strengthening our human defense layers. Implementing regular training and skepticism can be game changers. It’s also a reminder to design systems that lessen the impact of social engineering attacks. Stay vigilant and keep security awareness front and center in your teams! 🔐 #CyberSecurity #SocialEngineering #InfoSec #FullStackEngineer
